title: Marine Lines Mumbai 2021
description: A real photograph of Marine Drive and the Marine Lines skyline in South Mumbai at blue hour. This image illustrates Mumbai as a city setting; it is not a photograph of the event venue or BKC.
author: Dr Vikramjit Kakati
sourceRevision: Current Wikimedia Commons image, uploaded 2022-06-15; light adjustment and noise reduction, then tilt correction by UnpetitproleX.
changes: Resized to 2000 x 1334 and compressed to WebP. Presentation may use a responsive crop and CSS overlays.
